info.title: OpenAPI-to-Go Generator Test Cases
info.description: A collection of atomic OpenAPI 3.0 Schema Objects representing different structural variations and data types to thoroughly test a Go struct generator.

ReadWriteOnly.description: Tests readOnly and writeOnly property flags. Some generators produce separate request/response structs based on these flags.

id.description: Response-only field. Should be present in response struct, omitted or ignored in write requests.

password.description: Request-only field. Should be present in write requests, omitted or ignored in responses.
